headline: Executive order about the President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology, a group that advises the President.
what_it_does: This order deals with the President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology, a group of outside experts who give the President advice on science and technology topics. Based on the title alone, it appears to set up or renew this council and describe its role. No summary was provided, so details such as who serves on the council and what topics it covers are not available here.

who_it_affects.group: Scientists and technology experts outside government
who_it_affects.how: Some may be chosen to serve on the council and advise the President.

who_it_affects.group: White House staff and federal agencies
who_it_affects.how: They may work with the council or receive its advice.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 27, 2021; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
